name: simula-playable-agent
description: Playable simulation agent: loads any HTML5 playable, learns and plays it like a person under a virtual clock, records it at 30 fps with game audio, cuts a 20 s 9:16 highlight, flags friction and scores itself. Orchestrated with Pi Durable.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.ts && cd py && .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_track tests.test_impacts tests.test_audio -v
